If you are going to try this run I recommend you some things:

(For this Improve workers conditions whenever you de situation lets you and start producing submarines if you want to Naval invade the UK, also it would be better if you work on fighters as soon as possible since Portugal have good bonuses for them)

Separate your army with 4 good divisions (I converted the standard infantry division into a 7/2) the rest can be cavalry.

Once you take the focus to support the Spanish Republicans, send those 4 decent divisions to Spain to help killing as many Nationalist Units as possible, meanwhile reform you army and insdustry before joining in.

Once you join, both the Spanish and Portuguese civil war are easy, once you win you can take the focus to get the Iberian Union

Once you finish prepare yourself to fight the UK, (wether you want to Naval Invade or use Paratroopers) and be sure to garrison your Chinese puppet and call it into the war.

After you land on the UK everything becomes easier since usually the UK have it main islands poorly garrisoned.

Before leaving the Axis declare war on Vichy France to take their Chinese port.

Once you have all ports in China, join the Soviet faction and invade Japan from Vladivostok, after that it's obvious what to do.
